module_summary: Source half of a clearable two-phase CDC: accepted data is latched and a request toggle flips, with ready derived from a synchronized acknowledge toggle.

anchors.name: valid_i
anchors.why: Source valid; with ready_o accepts data and toggles request.

anchors.name: ready_o
anchors.why: Ready when request toggle equals synchronized ack toggle.

anchors.name: data_i
anchors.why: Source payload latched into data_src_q on handshake.

anchors.name: async_req_o
anchors.why: Two-phase request toggle to destination, copy of req_src_q.

anchors.name: async_ack_i
anchors.why: Asynchronous ack toggle from destination, synchronized into ack_synced.

anchors.name: async_data_o
anchors.why: Held payload crossing to destination domain from data_src_q.

anchors.name: data_src_q
anchors.why: Holds accepted data stable during the asynchronous transfer.

anchors.name: req_src_q
anchors.why: Request phase toggle register; flipped on accept, cleared by clear_i, compared with ack.

groups.name: src_handshake
groups.description: Two-phase request toggle and synchronized ack compare producing ready.

groups.name: data_hold
groups.description: Latches source data and drives it across the clock domain.
